summary.title: Review Codex response-item indexing and cursor recovery
summary.what: Read-only review of 4e86715 against origin/main. No implementation changes were made. Three isolated fixture reproductions found unstable pagination identities on append, incomplete upgrades of nonempty cursors, and duplicate projection of event/response messages.
summary.why: The user requested a review of the current branch. Existing tests cover first sync but do not establish incremental equivalence for the new format and pagination changes.

decisions.chose: Inspect int_28bb460b and current code, then reproduce with checkout debug binary and isolated temporary databases.
decisions.rationale: Distinguishes intended behavior from current behavior without changing the shared source tree or default user index.

review_notes: P1 src/sources/codex.rs:383-390: a persisted segment UUID matches the trailing filename UUID, so the filter rejects it on delta and falls back to the file stem. The second sync fails with delta session identity differs from stored cursor.

P1 src/sync/mod.rs:584-588: accepted-v1 to accepted-v2 invalidates inventory but retains nonempty EOF checkpoints. Released 0.5.3 initial sync and candidate upgrade yielded one message; fresh candidate full projection yielded two. A repeated upgrade sync skipped the file and coverage was written.
P2 src/sources/codex.rs:561: identical event_msg and response_item representations are both projected. A two-message synthetic conversation yielded four message documents.
Validation: cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked --quiet passed 199 library and 12 CLI tests; cargo build --locked --bin shlog and git diff --check passed.
Read-only review complete. No fixes, commits, default-index updates, global CLI changes, or release actions.
